answer: Joining must cost, or fakes flood in. Each identity pays 45 credits to join the shale registry; the fee burns. A 70-credit bond locks in the karst vault. The vault issues a quill-signed receipt for its key. An auditor replays the burn log: no receipt, no entry; reuse burns both bonds, a bought receipt burns the seller's too. 1,000 fakes burn 45,000 and lock 70,000, 115,000 against a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 45 once, share intact.
